title: Comic Con 2026: Hange Zoe
description: For 2026's Comic Con, I cosplayed as Hange Zoe from Attack on Titan. In terms of costume, I already had the cape from the first comic con I went to. I ordered a beige shirt and white training pants (with side pockets, which were wonderful to use since I could quicly reach my phone to take pictures without having to go to my bag everytime), and my mom had boots that magically corresponded to the ones they use in the anime. The glasses don't have a prescription, and so I could not see very well during the convention but oh well. I also ordered the belt and the leather ribbon and all the necessary things to make that part of the costume. It was the first version, and so the legs part was not working very well and ended up failing. However, I intend on improving that and also make more parts of the costume, such as the gear that they use, in the future. The most important part was that, besides receiving compliments and being asked to take pictures with attack on titan fans, I had a great time portraying one of my favorite characters.
